OneExperience Design System (ODS)



We are excited to introduce our advanced Multi-Brand Design System, representing a transformative approach to design that has the potential to enhance our products and user experiences across various brands, markets, and platforms. This meticulously crafted system has been thoughtfully designed to encompass flexibility, scalability, and innovation, aiming to establish a new benchmark for design within our organization. Included are Figma libraries and code components, comprehensive documentation, and a plugin designed to automate code generation from Figma files.



Scope

Over the course of the last months, we have put an immense effort in creating an as easy as possible to use DS pushing the limits of the Design, the Development and Code Generation Setup. Given our initial scope is to support 3 focus products, this means our active support has to be focused on those solely as they are our frontrunners of this effort. We will not be able to provide active support outside this scope for now - meaning more support than providing access to already existing materials in the Design and Dev repositories.

This Storybook page contains the OneID Theme components in code.

Please note that the ODS team has stopped supporting base theme as of 2026.

Visit the OneID Theme components storybook here


Key Features


Multi-Brand

The One DS is based on design tokens. It offers the flexibility to support different brands within the same system, while allowing each brand to maintain its individual visual identity. This scalability allows the system to grow and adapt as new brands are introduced. The streamlined workflow and unified approach results in significant time and cost savings. Designers and developers can focus on refining and improving the central design system instead of duplicating the work for each individual brand.

Multi-Platform

Our design system seamlessly spans multiple platforms, delivering a consistent user experience on web and app interfaces. TV integration is also planned for future integration, enhancing our commitment to a unified design experience across diverse digital landscapes.

Modes and Schemes

The seamless integration of tokens and variables empowers users to effortlessly switch between light and dark modes with a single click, ensuring a harmonious and consistent design experience. Furthermore, our components automatically adapt to specific color schemes, providing designers with increased speed and flexibility in the design process. This not only accelerates creativity but also promotes consistency and accessibility across all products.

Code Repository and Code Generation Figma Plugin

Within the One DS, you'll discover a set of global components, serving as the foundational building blocks for crafting designs tailored to your unique product specifications. These components are provided as a UI kit, written in various languages, including React and Flutter. The specifically designed and customized code generation Figma plugin automates the code generation. The global components are built with it and it also will enable product teams to develop new or product specific components efficiently. It allows to generate the code on component level but also whole code blocks on page level.

Accessibility

The design and code components are tested and comply with AA accessibility standards. Encompanied by AX guidelines the design system facilitates building accessible products and being prepared for the EAA, coming up 2025.

Brand compliance

The design system is available in Deutsche Telekom's new design language: the One Experience design identity. This is in line with Deutsche Telekom's brand values and Experience Principles.
